extension.summary: 雾汐｜Kodi 22 轻量透明皮肤，需 Mistuary Helper；搭配 Emby for Kodi NextGen 可自动同步媒体库
Lightweight transparent skin for Kodi 22, requires Mistuary Helper; syncs your Emby library with Emby for Kodi NextGen
extension.description:
基于 Estuary N 改造的小而美皮肤，需要 Kodi 22 及以上。 硬依赖 Mistuary Helper，请先安装插件再切换皮肤。
搭配 Emby for Kodi Next Gen（E4KNG）并登录，媒体库整体同步进 Kodi： 电影、剧集、季、集、评分与库封面开箱即用。
Mistuary Helper 提供：详情页豆瓣评分、媒体库封面同步、 播放列表补全（按季 / 按目录 / 跨季）与文件播放记录（不写 Kodi 原生续播点）。
搜索走 Emby 服务端，支持中文 / 原名 / 全拼 / 首字母 / 英文人名 / 类型； 搜索页支持全键盘输入与手机 App 文本注入。 评分胶囊支持 TMDb / IMDb / 豆瓣，主评分四档可选，一行最多两颗； 技术标识按分辨率 / HDR / 杜比视界档位 / 编码 / 声道图标化。
电视剧季视图即剧集详情版式，季标签与本季集卡片同屏。 透黑 / 透白双主题，页面 / 弹窗 / 播放中三档透明度各 6 级； 8 套屏幕比例自适应，另有音乐黑胶模式与电源菜单。

A compact, polished skin built on Estuary N. Requires Kodi 22 or newer. Hard dependency on the Mistuary Helper add-on - install it before switching skins.
With Emby for Kodi Next Gen installed and signed in, your library syncs into Kodi: movies, shows, seasons, episodes, ratings and library covers work out of the box.
Mistuary Helper provides Douban ratings in the video info dialog, library cover sync, playlist completion (by season / folder / next season) and file playback resume (Kodi's native resume points are not touched).
Search runs on the Emby server and matches Chinese titles, original titles, full pinyin, initials, English names and genres; the search page supports full keyboard input and text injection from mobile apps. Ratings from TMDb / IMDb / Douban, up to two capsules per row; technical flags are shown as icons (resolution, HDR, Dolby Vision profile, codecs, channels).
TV seasons open in a detail-style page with season tabs and episode cards on one screen. Dark and light transparent themes with six levels each for pages, popups and playback; eight aspect ratios supported, plus a vinyl mode and a power menu.
extension.disclaimer: Weather, radio and game browsing surfaces are intentionally omitted.
本皮肤有意省略天气、电台和游戏浏览界面。
